mysticism.skill.butcher.description:
§bPassive§r: physical hits build marks; 10 marks cause Rupturing.
§6Heighten§r §epress§r: toggle ×2 movement/attack speed.
§6Rupture§r §epress§r: pick a foe with 15+ marks.
§6血淋林的爱§r §epress§r: butchering menu for your last hit target; needs a charge from a marked kill.
mysticism.skill.captivator.description:
Charms creatures and buffs followers within 20 blocks.
§6Performance§r §ehold§r: charm/inspire; release switches Truth/Lie.
§6Masquerade§r §epress§r: heal/buff allies, blind foes for 10s.
§6Unveil§r §epress§r: paralyse for 10s; mastered adds Marked for Death.
§6Star Power§r §epress§r: Dazzled for 10s on foes looking at you (mastered).
mysticism.skill.clangorous_soul.descript:
Taunts non-allied mobs within 10 blocks (15 mastered), making them target you; also angers neutral mobs.
§ePress§r to taunt.
mysticism.skill.coalescence.description:
Freezes foes in place and raises shields.
§6Fixation§r §epress§r: target within 10 blocks for 10s (15 blocks, 20s mastered).
§6Solidification§r §epress§r: shield for 20s (40 mastered); §esneak+press§r at it to remove.
§6Eternal Domain§r §epress§r: Fixation field for 20s (40 mastered), 10,000 magicule.
§eToggle§r: block Slowness/Burden.
mysticism.skill.constant.description:
Locks health or attack damage.
§6Constant: Health§r §ehold§r: restore health after hits, up to 15s; 1,000 magicule/s.
§6Constant: Physical§r §epress§r: record strongest hit over 5s.
§6Constant: Destruction§r §ehold§r: recorded damage (cap 5,000), up to 10s; 3,000 magicule/s.
§6Constant: Energy§r §epress§r: defer costs for 10s, repay ×2 (mastered).
mysticism.skill.corroder.description:
§bPassive§r: toggle to coat physical hits in Corrosion II for 10s (III, 15s mastered).
§6Dissolve§r §ehold§r: 10 damage every 0.5s within 10 blocks (15 damage/blocks mastered), plus Corrosion.
§6Cross Corrosion§r §epress§r: toggle ×2 corrosion damage on sword hits.
mysticism.skill.corrosion_transform.desc:
Hurts nearby enemies and applies Corrosion; your physical hits add Corrosion II while active. You move slower.
§eHold§r to keep it up.
mysticism.skill.crasher.description:
Void aura damages foes within 15 blocks: 25/s (50 mastered); weaker foes are slowed. May give YOU Insanity.
§6Destroyer Haki§r §ehold§r: aura on.
§6Dimension Hopper§r §escroll§r: choose dimension; §ehold, release§r: travel.
§eToggle§r: Thought Acceleration.
mysticism.skill.cryogenic_cessation.desc:
Ice power ×1.5; physical hits inflict Chill I (III mastered) for 10s while toggled.
§eToggle§r: on/off.
§6Ice Breath§r §ehold§r: 16 damage (32 mastered); 500 magicule/s.
§6Freezing Point§r §epress§r: replace terrain 8 blocks around and 16 down with ice; 1,000 magicule.
mysticism.skill.cultivator.description:
§bPassive§r: empty-handed physical hits deal +50 damage (+100 mastered).
§eToggle§r: more magicule gained.
§6Breakthrough§r §epress§r after 1,000 mob kills: cultivate for 300s. Dying during cultivation resets progress. Cooldown 180s.
mysticism.skill.darkness_domination.desc:
Dark abilities ×3 while toggled.
§eToggle§r: boost on/off.
§eHold§r: darkness beam, 20 base damage, 15-block reach; costs magicules.
mysticism.skill.darkness_manipulation.de:
Dark abilities ×1.5 while toggled.
§ePress§r: dark cube within 15 blocks, radius 5, for 15s; 10 damage (20 mastered) and Movement Interference. 800 magicule.
§eSneak+press§r at your cube: dismiss.
§eToggle§r: boost on/off.
mysticism.skill.discharge.description:
Lightning strike: 15 damage in a 3-block radius, up to 30 blocks away. Works in any weather. 1,000 magicule.
§ePress§r where you aim.
mysticism.skill.dissonance.description:
Lightning hits each creature within 5 blocks, including allies: 30 damage, 5-block blasts. If none are nearby, strikes where you aim (30 blocks). 10,000 magicule.
§ePress§r.
mysticism.skill.dreamer.description:
Saves your health, energy and position; restores them on return or death.
§6Dream§r §epress§r: save (25% max magicule)/return; §esneak+press§r: cancel save.
§6Hypnosis§r §ehold§r: Drowsiness within 10 blocks (15 mastered).
§6Dream Eater§r §ehold 5s§r at a drowsy foe: 30 damage +30 spiritual (50+50 mastered).
mysticism.skill.engineer.description:
Builds a shooting sentry or a food/energy dispenser for 500 magicule.
§6Build§r §escroll§r: choose building; §ehold 5s§r at solid ground.
§6Bubble Shield§r §epress§r on solid ground: barrier for 15s (30 mastered).
mysticism.skill.gardener.description:
§eToggle§r: speeds crop growth within 10 blocks; costs 100 magicule per growth check.
§6Blessing§r §epress§r holding food: adds Strengthen at dawn, Resistance at noon, Speed at night when eaten.
§6Overgrow§r §epress§r: no growth boost found.
§6Entwine§r §epress§r: selects foes only; no effect found.
mysticism.skill.gatekeeper.description:
Binds foes and fires stored weapons through gates.
§6Enkidu§r §epress§r: bind target within 10 blocks for 120s (240 mastered); press again to free. 25,000 magicule.
§6Kings Storehouse§r §epress§r: weapon storage.
§6Gate Of Babylon§r §ehold§r: fire; 25,000 magicule/s.
§eSneak+press§r: Direct Fire/Surround Attack.
mysticism.skill.gravitational_void.descr:
Black hole pulls in creatures, items and blocks for 60s (180 mastered). Core: 50 gravity + 50 magic damage, scaling up to 250 + 250. 500,000 magicule.
§eHold 20s (6s mastered), release§r.
mysticism.skill.gravity_flux.description:
Disrupts one foe for 10s; range 15 blocks (20 mastered). Effects are level I (II mastered).
§6Fluctuate§r §epress§r: bob them up/down and cause Nausea.
§6Hamper§r §epress§r: apply Burden.
mysticism.skill.hell_hall.description:
Turns the 9×9 floor below you into flowing lava. Water in that area stops it; requires skill griefing. 5,000 magicule.
§ePress§r to melt the floor.
mysticism.skill.hidden_ruler.description:
Copies Common, Extra or Intrinsic skills; duplicates enter a bank.
§6Copy§r §epress§r: copy; §esneak+press§r: view bank.
§6Paste§r §epress§r: give banked skill; §esneak+press§r: select.
§6Clear Bank§r §epress§r, then §esneak+press§r within 3s: erase bank.
§6Darkness Conscription§r §epress§r: charm; both light levels below 5.
§eToggle§r: conceal presence.
mysticism.skill.ice_domination.descripti:
Boosts ice abilities while toggled.
§eToggle§r: boost on/off.
§eHold§r: ice breath, 12 damage (24 mastered); 500 magicule/s.
mysticism.skill.jinchuriki.description:
Charged bomb: 6 damage × power; above ×3 adds a 150-damage blast.
§6Tailed Beast Bomb§r §ehold, release§r: charge/fire; minimum 1s (0.5 mastered). Each ×1 costs 800 magicule +200 aura.
§6Tailed Beast Cloak§r §epress§r: berserk clone until 250 uses, then controllable cloak.
§eSneak+press§r: check uses/state.
mysticism.skill.kyurem.description:
Freezing attacks slow foes.
§6Glaciate§r §ehold§r: damage within 15 blocks rises to 100 (200 mastered).
§6Draconic Pulse§r §epress§r: 40-damage shot, 7.5-block blast.
§6Freeze Dry§r §ehold§r at a foe within 5 blocks: 20 damage.
§6Blizzard§r §ehold§r: 7.5-block storm, 40 damage plus Chill.
mysticism.skill.light_domination.descrip:
Light arrows: 20 damage each, aimed up to 30 blocks away.
§ePress§r: 10 arrows (15 mastered).
§eToggle§r: light abilities ×3; mastery weakens enemy light resistance.
mysticism.skill.light_manipulation.descr:
A light beam: 20 damage, reaches 30 blocks.
§eHold§r: keep firing.
§eToggle§r: light abilities ×1.5.
mysticism.skill.lightning_mode.descripti:
+12 attack damage and a large speed boost for 180s (360 mastered); doubles current aura and magicule. Ending halves both and gives Weakness II, Fragility II and Paralysis for 600s.
§ePress§r: transform or end early. Cooldown 60s.
mysticism.skill.malleable.description:
Defensive healing and a clay body.
§6Alchemy§r §epress§r: active for 10s (toggle mastered); effect not found. §eSneak+hold§r: check element; §esneak+scroll§r: select.
§6Harden§r §ehold§r: Regen V, Resistance II, +10 armor for up to 10s (15 mastered); cannot move/attack.
§6Vessel§r §epress§r: inert Clay Golem, 50 HP (200 mastered).
mysticism.skill.melancholy.description:
§eToggle§r: aura slows nearby creatures and you; gives you Resistance II.
§6Gust§r §epress§r: push target; §esneak+press§r: pull. No target: throw held item or air (75 damage, 100 mastered).
§6Turbulent Force§r §ehold§r: move target.
§6Grief§r §epress§r: shove within 8 blocks, Blindness/Weakness for 10s.
§eScroll§r: range, 3–15 blocks (50 mastered).
mysticism.skill.mithril_strength.descrip:
Strengthen III for 60s (IV for 120s mastered). 10,000 magicule.
§ePress§r: buff yourself.
§eToggle§r (mastered): sustain Strengthen III; drains magicule.
mysticism.skill.paralysis_transform.desc:
Hurts nearby enemies and applies Paralysis; your physical hits add Paralysis II while active. You move slower.
§eHold§r to keep it up.
mysticism.skill.phaser.description:
Dodges hits with 5s intangibility; overuse limits it.
§6Eject§r §ehold 3s (1.5 mastered), release§r: fire stored items; §esneak+press§r: storage.
§6Authority Of The Gods§r §esneak+hold 3s (1.5 mastered), release§r: enter/leave Kamui; without sneak, warp a foe (mastered).
§6Intangibility§r §epress§r: phase (mastered).
§6Intangibility: Toggle§r §epress§r: auto-dodge on/off (mastered).
mysticism.skill.poison_transform.descrip:
Hurts nearby enemies and applies Fatal Poison; your physical hits add Fatal Poison II while active. You move slower.
§eHold§r to keep it up.
mysticism.skill.profaned_prominence.desc:
Melts ground and breathes fire.
§eToggle§r: fire ×1.5; hits burn for 15s (30s mastered).
§6Fire Breath§r §ehold§r: 16 damage (32 mastered).
§6Providence§r §epress§r: lava within 8 blocks, down 16; fails if water is there. 1,000 magicule.
mysticism.skill.provider.description:
Halo boosts other creatures and their projectiles; builds Contributions.
§6Generosity§r §epress§r: summon halo, 1,000 magicule +500/s; others' shots deal ×3 damage.
§6Pay It Forward§r §epress§r: 1,000+ Contributions grant speed, step height and ×1.5–5 damage; 1,500 magicule +750/s.
§eSneak+press§r: end halo/buff in its mode.
mysticism.skill.reducer.description:
§bPassive§r: faster aura/magicule regeneration; toggle lowers spell cost.
§6Emancipation§r §epress§r: holy hits at ×1.75 attack damage.
§6Purity Edge§r §epress§r: next hit adds 25% target max HP (50% mastered); 10,000 magicule. Hit within 3s (5s mastered) or lose 75% max HP (25% mastered).
mysticism.skill.relapse.description:
Race-dependent clones and buffs.
§ePress§r selected mode.
§6Aleph§r: one clone; §esneak+press§r: dismiss.
§6Bet§r: 5–10 decoys for 30s.
§6Gimel§r: kills buy a Possession body, or holy attacks for 30s.
§6Daleth§r: flight + Revenant Horror or Awakened Foresight.
§6Aleph: Null§r: Inferius consumes Aleph for Collective; Excelsius clone buff may fail.
mysticism.skill.repeater.description:
Toggle: physical hits deal a second hit.
§6Recursion Depth§r §epress§r: record hits for 5s, then deal ×1.5 their total again. Each hit after the first is 90% of the last.
§6Flarefrost Storehouse§r §epress§r: store/retrieve Axiom in main hand and Waltz in offhand.
mysticism.skill.reshiram.description:
Toggle: +150% fire boost.
§6Blue Flare§r §epress§r: 60-damage fire field, size 20, lasts 5s.
§6Fusion Flare§r §epress§r: pulling fire field, 200 damage, size 5.
§6Draconic Meteor§r §epress§r: 70 damage, 10-block blast.
§6Flamethrower§r §ehold§r: fire breath, 30 damage.
mysticism.skill.restricted.description:
§bPassive§r: stronger physical/Battlewill attacks; toggle boosts speed and armor.
§6Dash§r §epress§r: blink 12 blocks (16 mastered), striking along the path for attack damage +25 (+75 mastered). Needs ground or water.
§6Counter§r §epress§r: parry a physical hit within 3s (5s mastered), imbalancing its attacker for 5s; press again to cancel.
mysticism.skill.scholar.description:
Toggle: faster skill learning/mastery. 20% chance to study attackers, building dodge chance against that player or mob type. Unlocks all schematics.
§ePress§r: open enchanted-book storage to manage enchantments; allows up to 5 bonus levels.
mysticism.skill.spiritualist.description:
Harvest soul points with a scythe; spend them to boost damage.
§6Summon Scythe§r §epress§r, empty main hand: summon/dismiss.
§6Carve§r §epress§r with scythe: sweep foes within 5 blocks for soul points.
§6Enhance§r §ehold+scroll§r: set soul output (0–100%).
Toggle: faster chanting and thinking.
mysticism.skill.stagnator.description:
Stops movement and attacks.
§6Stagnate Aura§r §ehold§r: Stagnate and Silence within 25 blocks.
§6Inaction§r §ehold§r: immobilize yourself; block non-spiritual damage.
§6Stasis Coat§r §epress§r: Severance Blade I for 5s; again to remove.
§6Stasis Shot§r §epress§r: projectile, 50 damage (100 mastered).
mysticism.skill.subjugator.description:
Control eligible foes; command followers.
§ePress§r by mode:
§6Takeover§r: control within 5 blocks (10 mastered).
§6Communication Movement§r: group orders; §esneak+press§r: one.
§6Communication Targeting§r: attack orders.
§6Unbreakable Defense§r: disables other toggles; defense benefit not checked.
§6Return§r: loyalty count.
§6The Voice§r: awakened dialogue.
In targeting mode, §esneak+scroll§r: reply; §erelease§r: send; §esneak+release§r: cancel.
mysticism.skill.victorious_harbinger.des:
§bPassive§r: blocks Fear and Mind Control. Toggle: +10% attack speed.
§6Might§r §ehold§r: fear aura.
§6Tenacious Resolve§r §epress§r: harmful effects lose one level (minimum I) and 25% of remaining time. 500 magicule.
mysticism.skill.zekrom.description:
Toggle: +150% lightning boost.
§6Bolt Strike§r §epress§r: lightning, 150 damage, radius 7.5.
§6Fusion Bolt§r §ehold, release§r: dash 15 blocks, hitting for 60 damage.
§6Draconic Breath§r §ehold§r: 60-damage breath.
§6Thunderbolt§r §epress§r: lightning, 100 damage, 30-block range.
tensura.skill.absolute_severance.descrip:
Severing melee coat or flying slash.
§6Severance Coat§r §epress§r: Severance Blade V (XX mastered) for 600s; again to remove.
§6Severance Cutter§r §epress§r: 50 damage (300 mastered), size 5 (8 mastered). 20,000 magicule.
tensura.skill.acid_shell.description:
Acid ball: 175 damage and 300 armor durability damage. Mastered: adds Corrosion II for 20s. Costs 38,000 magicule.
§eHold 4s, release§r to fire.
tensura.skill.aerial_blade.description:
Pulls nearby foes toward your aim, then deals 200 damage. Reaches 3 blocks (4 mastered). 35,000 magicule.
§eHold 5s, release§r.
tensura.skill.agility.description:
Speed III and Haste III for 120s (600 mastered). Costs 3,000 magicule.
§eHold 5s, release§r: buff yourself.
§eSneak+release§r: buff the target you aim at within 10 blocks instead.
tensura.skill.air_flight.description:
Fly where you look; release in midair to hover.
§ePress§r: stop falling.
§eHold§r: fly forward.
§eSneak+release§r: fall normally.
§eScroll§r (mastered): move up/down.
tensura.skill.airflow_shut.description:
Airless sphere suffocates targets and applies Silence I for 5s. Lasts 10s.
§eHold 5s§r at a target within 20 blocks; keep holding to sustain, 1,300 magicule/s.
§6Expanded§r (mastered): larger sphere.
tensura.skill.analyst.description:
Toggle: faster chanting, thinking and skill learning/mastery.
§6Analytical Appraisal§r §epress§r: scan 20 blocks (25 mastered). §eSneak+press§r: entities/blocks/both.
§6Analyze§r §ehold§r at a copiable magic projectile within 30 blocks: learn its spell after 5s (3s mastered; chant speed helps).
tensura.skill.analyze.description:
Raises analysis by 1 level and 5 blocks range (2 levels and 10 blocks mastered), revealing target stats.
§eHold 2s§r, then keep holding to analyse; §erelease§r to stop.
tensura.skill.anti_magic_area.descriptio:
Blocks Aspectual and Summoning Magic in a 10-block radius (25 mastered) for 60s. Costs 20,000 magicule.
§eHold 11s, release§r: create zone.
§eSneak+press§r looking at your zone: remove it.
tensura.skill.anti_shock_area.descriptio:
Reduces physical damage inside a 7.5-block radius for 120s (15 blocks, 180s mastered). Costs 15,000 magicule.
§eHold 11s, release§r: create zone.
§eSneak+press§r looking at your zone: remove it.
tensura.skill.antidote.description:
Removes Nausea, Poison and Weakness; mastered also weakens Fatal Poison. Costs 2,500 magicule.
§eHold 6s, release§r at a target within 6 blocks, or aim away to treat yourself.
tensura.skill.aura_slash.description:
Ranged slash: ×1 weapon damage (×2 mastered). Needs a sword or axe. 50 aura.
§ePress§r: fire; mastered fires from both hands if both hold weapons.
tensura.skill.aura_sword.description:
Adds +100% weapon damage to direct physical hits for 60s. 200 aura.
§ePress§r: apply or remove.
Mastered: §etoggle§r to sustain, draining aura.
tensura.skill.barrier.description:
Physical protection for 10s (20 mastered): blocks small hits and subtracts damage from larger ones, scaled to health when cast. Costs 5% of base max magicule, minimum 2,000.
§eHold 8s, release§r.
tensura.skill.battlewill.description:
Converts magicules to aura at 1:1, using 1% of your max magicules every 1.5s (2% mastered).
§eHold§r: convert until your aura is full.
tensura.skill.beast_transformation.descr:
Full heal and energy refill; +15 attack, +10 armor, faster movement and ×2 energy capacity for 180s (360 mastered). Ending gives Weakness II, Fragility II and Paralysis for 600s.
§ePress§r: transform or end early. Cooldown 60s.
tensura.skill.berserk.description:
Toggle: ×2 fire boost; melee hits burn foes.
§6Rage§r §epress§r: Strengthen V (X mastered) for 300s; again to end.
§6Mad Ogre§r §epress§r: transform for 600s, 5,000 magicule; Rampage for 30s. Mastered: press again to fire/summon orbs (100 damage).
§eSneak+press§r: end form. Mastered: §esneak§r to spend an orb and halve a hit.
tensura.skill.berserker.description:
Armor, attack and speed scale with EP; mastered attack bonus doubles. Damages enemy equipment faster. Toggle boosts EP gains.
§eHold 2s§r: transform.
§eHold again§r: end transformation.
tensura.skill.bewilder.description:
Mind-controls eligible non-spiritual foes.
§6Target§r §epress§r: control for 600s; §esneak+press§r: release.
§6Area§r §epress§r: control within 10 blocks (15 mastered) for 300s. Resistance halves control time.
§6Charm§r §epress§r: Hero of the Village V for 120s.
§6Kill§r §epress§r: controlled foes nearby take their current HP as damage (half if resistant).
tensura.skill.black_flame.description:
Black flames and explosive shots.
§eToggle§r: hits inflict Black Burn for 10s.
§6Flame Breath§r §ehold§r: 9 fire + 1 magic damage (18 + 2 mastered).
§6Fireball§r §epress§r: 45 fire + 5 magic.
§6Hell Flare§r §epress§r: 270 + 30, radius 15.
§6Limited Hell Flare§r §epress§r: 720 + 80, radius 2.5. Both flares cost 2,000 magicule.
tensura.skill.black_lightning.descriptio:
Lightning + magic damage; aim up to 50 blocks.
§ePress§r for bolts:
§6Default Power§r: 45 + 5 damage, radius 8.
§6Decreased Power§r: 22.5 + 2.5, radius 5.
§6Increased Power§r: 135 + 15, radius 12.
§6Blast§r §ehold§r: 22.5 + 2.5 beam, range 30.
§6Death Storm§r §epress§r: bolts and tornadoes within 30; 5,000 magicule. Again to stop.
tensura.skill.blood_mist.description:
Life-stealing mist; costs 20 HP to summon.
§6Default§r §epress§r: place a 5-block mist within 10; press again: explode for 100 damage.
§6Blood Ray§r §ehold§r: 40-block beam, 50 damage; costs 10 HP per 0.5s and 10,000 magicule. Requires mastery and 500,000 EP.
tensura.skill.body_armor.description:
Summons Armorsaurus armor into empty armor slots. 50 magicule.
§ePress§r: equip; with all slots filled, removes summoned pieces.
§eSneak+press§r: summon a gauntlet in an empty main hand, or remove it.
tensura.skill.body_double.description:
A fighting clone using 10% of your maximum magicule.
§6Clone Creation§r §epress§r: summon.
§6Clone Control§r §epress§r at your clone within 50: swap bodies; leaves your original still and gives Fragility II and Energy Blockade V. Stay within 50 of your original or take damage.
§eSneak+press§r in Control: dismiss a moving clone.
tensura.skill.burden.description:
Gravity projectile applies Burden III and Slowness II for 30s, making targets heavy and slow.
§eHold 4s, release§r to fire.
tensura.skill.chain_explosion.descriptio:
3 chained blasts: 200 damage each in a 10-block radius (300 damage, 15 blocks mastered), 1.5s apart. Costs 80,000 magicule.
§eHold 7s, release§r at a spot within 32 blocks.
tensura.skill.charm.description:
Charms a target within 5 blocks: EP ≤25% of yours gives control for 300s (600 mastered); ≤50% makes it neutral. Spiritual resistance lowers these limits. Cost: target EP +80 magicule.
§ePress§r at a target.
§eSneak+press§r: undo your charm.
tensura.skill.chef.description:
Heals missing HP, clears severance damage and removes harmful effects except skill effects. Costs 60 magicule per HP (40 mastered), 100 per effect.
§ePress§r: heal yourself.
§eSneak+press§r: heal a target within 5 blocks.
tensura.skill.chosen_one.description:
Toggle: Hero of the Village V. Equipped: Luck V and buffs to allies within 15 blocks.
§6Hero's Haki§r §ehold§r: fear aura.
§6Hero's Charisma§r §epress§r: control eligible foes within 10 blocks for 120s (60s if resistant).
§eScroll§r (mastered): Power Scale.
tensura.skill.clairvoyance.description:
Zooms your view while held.
§eHold 1s§r, then keep holding to look; §erelease§r to stop.
§eScroll§r: zoom (limit 50; 25 mastered).
tensura.skill.confusion.description:
Confuses foes within 10 blocks for 15s (20 mastered), up to level III (IV mastered). Fails above ×1.5 your EP. Costs 2,000 magicule.
§eHold 5s, release§r.
tensura.skill.cook.description:
Toggle: +100% crit and dodge-negation chance; faster skill learning/mastery. Hits can break multilayer barriers.
§6Chaotic Fate§r §epress§r: arm max-HP reduction on your next hit; stays active when mastered.
§eSneak+press§r: restore a target's lost max HP within 6 blocks.
tensura.skill.create_greater_undead.desc:
Summons an armed undead ally with 100 HP. 8,000 magicule each.
§eHold 6s, then keep holding 2s§r.
§6Zombie§r: zombie.
§6Skeleton§r: skeleton.
§6Random Undead§r: either.
§eSneak while casting§r: 3 allies (6 mastered). Aim at solid ground.
tensura.skill.create_lesser_undead.descr:
Summons an undead ally with 20 HP and 5 attack damage.
§eHold 4s, then keep holding 2s§r.
§6Zombie§r: zombie.
§6Skeleton§r: skeleton.
§6Random Undead§r: either.
§eSneak while casting§r (mastered): 3 allies. Aim at solid ground.
tensura.skill.creator.description:
Creates temporary Unique skills from the configured list.
§6Analytical Appraisal§r §epress§r: inspect targets; mastered scans 5 blocks. §eSneak+press§r: entities/blocks/both.
§6Skill Creation§r §epress§r: open skill creation menu; skill lasts 60s, 60s cooldown.
tensura.skill.curse.description:
Mist around you: 5-block radius for 20s; 40 damage (60 mastered) every 2s and Curse I (II mastered) for 30s. 10,000 magicule.
§eHold 6s, release§r.
tensura.skill.curse_bind.description:

§eHold 4s§r: bind, then keep §eholding§r for up to 5s (10s mastered).
§eRelease§r: stop binding.
tensura.skill.mud_spears.description:
Ground spikes; 70,000 magicule.
§eHold 4s, release§r.
§6Targeted Mode§r: foe within 20 blocks; 250 damage plus 50 earth. With Mud Hand active: 2s cast, +50 damage.
§6Spread Mode§r (mastered): rings around you, 5-block radius; 20 damage, lasts 30s. Stand on ground.
tensura.skill.multilayer_barrier.descrip:
Blocks up to ×1.5 your max HP per hit; 5 magicule per damage stopped. Bigger hits break it.
§ePress§r: self on/off.
§eSneak+press§r at an ally within 5: on/off, blocks ×0.75 their max HP per hit.
tensura.skill.murderer.description:
Hides your presence (Concealment III) and mutes your sounds; +50 attack damage (150 mastered). 50 magicule.
§eHold§r to stay hidden. Once mastered, §epress§r to toggle.
tensura.skill.musician.description:
Sound attacks that ignore armor.
§6Sonic Blast§r §epress§r: 75 damage in a line, 8 blocks (150, 12 mastered).
§6Sound Wave§r §epress§r: 40 damage within 5 blocks of you (75 mastered).
§6Mind Requiem§r §epress§r: 150 damage (+100 to spirits) in front, 10 blocks.
tensura.skill.observer.description:
§bPassive§r: dodge 20% melee, 100% projectiles.
§6Danger Detection§r warns when a mob targets you.
§6Presence Detection§r shows monsters, traps or treasure through walls. §eSneak+press§r: switch what is shown.
§ePress§r to toggle.
tensura.skill.ogre_berserker.description:
+30 attack damage, +10 armor and faster movement for 180s (360 mastered). Costs 5,000 magicule. Weakness II, Fragility II and Paralysis for 600s afterward.
§ePress§r to transform; §epress again§r to end early.
tensura.skill.ogre_flame.description:
Fire pillar where you aim, within 15 blocks: 50 damage, radius 4.
§eHold 5s§r, then keep holding to sustain it for up to 5s (10s mastered), spending aura.
tensura.skill.ogre_sword_cannon.descript:
Piercing aura blade: ×2–4 attack damage (up to ×6.5 mastered), through mobs and blocks. Costs 200–1,000 aura (up to 2,000 mastered).
§eHold at least 2s (1s mastered), release§r. Longer = stronger and larger.
tensura.skill.oppressor.description:
Control gravity.
§6Repel§r and §6Attract§r §ehold§r: push away (10 blocks) or pull (30); power builds up to 10. Number keys set power (mastered).
§6Oppress§r §epress§r: 100 damage (200 mastered), Oppression and Burden II for 30s.
§6Bleve§r §epress§r: same damage, launches the target.
§6Flicker§r §ehold, release§r: dash forward.
tensura.skill.poisonous_breath.descripti:
Poison breath ahead: 15 damage (30 mastered) and Fatal Poison I for 10s. Costs 100 magicule/s.
§eHold§r to breathe.
tensura.skill.predator.description:
Devouring mist, 10 damage at 3 blocks.
§6Predation§r §epress§r: mist. §eSneak+press§r: set Blocks/Fluid/All/None.
§6Analysis§r §epress§r: refining menu. §6Stomach§r §epress§r: storage.
§6Isolation§r §epress§r: remove effects, 200 magicule.
§6Mimicry§r: not implemented.
tensura.skill.pride.description:
When a skill or effect hits you, copy it: 20% chance (100% mastered), then a 45s cooldown. Copies become sub-modes.
§6Copy§r §epress§r or §ehold§r uses the selected copy.
§eScroll§r: passed to the copied skill (not checked).
tensura.skill.protection.description:
Protection I adds 20 armor for 120s (600s mastered).
§eHold 5s, release§r: on yourself.
§eSneak+cast§r: on the creature you aim at, within 10 blocks.
tensura.skill.ranged_barrier.description:
Breakable barrier for 60s (120 mastered).
§ePress§r: place within 30 blocks.
§65x5x5 Barrier§r: radius 2.
§610x10x10 Barrier§r: radius 5.
§620x20x20 Barrier§r: radius 10; mastered.
§eSneak+press§r at yours: remove.
tensura.skill.reaper.description:
Small form (×0.5 size): wider Presence Sense, 15% melee and projectile dodge (30 mastered).
§ePress§r to toggle.
§6Attack§r §epress§r: summon clones that copy your stats and skills. §eScroll§r: how many (max 5).
§6Infinite Eater§r §epress§r a target (reach +3): kills it if its EP is lower, steals EP. Toggle off first.
tensura.skill.recovery.description:
Heals up to 50% of max HP. Target players also gain 4 food (8 mastered). Costs 100 magicule per HP healed, minimum 10,000.
§eHold 5s, release§r: heal your target within 6 blocks, or yourself if none.
tensura.skill.reflector.description:
Stores damage you take as echo, then fires it back.
§6Echo Reflection§r §epress§r: piercing echo shot, ×3 damage (×5 mastered). §eSneak+scroll§r: its size.
§6Echo Counter§r: melee hits return ×2.5 damage, projectiles fly back faster. Movement locked until mastered.
tensura.skill.reincarnation.description:
Resets your race and race data, removes race-granted/temporary skills and clears warp points. Keeps 75% of base max aura and magicule. Requires 10,000 magicule.
§eHold 10s, release§r: reset and open reincarnation menu.
tensura.skill.reinforced_barrier.descrip:
HP-scaled damage barriers. Costs 5% of max magicule, minimum 5,000.
§eHold 8s, release§r.
§6Combined Barrier§r: magic and physical defense for 30s.
Mastered: §6Magic Defense§r or §6Physical Defense§r: stronger single-type barrier for 15s.
tensura.skill.reinforcement.description:
Reinforcement III reduces gear durability loss for 120s (600s mastered).
§eHold 5s, release§r: on yourself.
§eSneak+cast§r: on the creature you aim at, within 10 blocks.
tensura.skill.researcher.description:
Engrave enchantments on gear; bonus levels up to +1.
§ePress§r: spatial storage.
§eSneak+press§r: engraving menu.
Engraving can leave a curse.
tensura.skill.reverser.description:
Flip things to their opposite.
§6Alignment Reverse§r §epress§r at a target within 3 blocks: flip chaos/order.
§6Inverted Fusion§r Buff: target's buffs become debuffs. Debuff: debuffs become buffs. §ePress§r.
Mastered: toggle to turn your debuffs into buffs; §epress§r an item to reverse curses (10,000 magicule).
tensura.skill.roaring_lion_punch.descrip:
Punch: attack damage +1 per 10 aura spent. Uses 10% of max aura, capped at 2,000 (4,000 mastered).
§ePress§r at a foe with an empty hand or fist weapon.
tensura.skill.royal_beast.description:
Beast form for 180s (360 mastered): massive physical boost, health set to full. 60s cooldown.
§ePress§r to transform.
tensura.skill.sacred_haki.description:
Fears foes under half your EP; heals allies 60 HP every 5s and clears harmful effects.
§6Magicule Release§r §ehold§r: aura, 15 blocks.
§6Magicule Coat§r §epress§r: Haki Coat for 120s; again to end.
§eScroll§r in Release (mastered): Power Scale.
tensura.skill.search_enemy.description:
Highlights nearby hostile mobs.
§eHold 2s, release§r: lasts 120s; §epress§r again to end.
§6Constant§r: §ehold§r for 2s, then keep holding to maintain it for 5 magicule per second.
tensura.skill.seeker.description:
Copies eligible projectile magic within 15 blocks.
§eHold§r on the same shot for 3s (1s mastered) to learn it.
§eToggle§r: faster chanting, movement and attacks.
§bPassive§r: grants Law Manipulation.
tensura.skill.seer.description:
While toggled: +25% melee/projectile dodge, +33% crit; direct melee hits deal ×0.7 damage (50%, 50%, ×0.5 mastered).
§eToggle§r: these bonuses.
§ePress§r: +100% dodge, crit and dodge negation for 10s (20 mastered); press again to end.
tensura.skill.severer.description:
Creates spatial swords and flying blades.
§6Dummy Sword§r §epress§r: fill an empty hand.
§6Blade Storm§r §epress§r with a spatial sword: 5 blades (10 mastered); 2,000 magicule.
§6Severance§r §epress§r: +10 attack (+20 mastered) for 120s.
tensura.skill.shadow_bind.description:
Binds a grounded foe for 10s, dealing 10 spiritual damage (+1% of its max spiritual health mastered). Needs shadow until mastered.
§eHold 2s, release§r at a foe within 10 blocks.
tensura.skill.shadow_striker.description:
Dash attacks and direct soul damage.
§6Ultra Acceleration§r §epress§r on ground: dash 15 blocks (20 mastered), striking foes.
§6Insta-kill§r: melee hits deal 500 soul damage (1,000 mastered); 3,000 magicule.
§6Espionage§r §ehold§r: concealment; mastered: §epress§r to toggle.
§eToggle skill§r: faster chanting, movement, attacks and better dodges.
tensura.skill.sleep_mist.description:
Sleeping mist around you: 5-block radius, Paralysis II. Cloud lasts 15s (25s mastered). 5,000 magicule.
§eHold 5s, release§r.
tensura.skill.sloth.description:
Drowsiness, magicule drain and healing.
§6Deep Hypno§r §ehold§r: drowsy target; §epress§r: cancel a spell.
§6Fallen Hypno§r §ehold§r: drowsy aura, 5 blocks (10 mastered).
§6Deprive§r §ehold§r: drain 1,000 magicule/s.
§6Rest§r §ehold§r: heal 10 HP/s; §esneak+press§r: heal allies.
§6Phantasmal Style§r §epress§r to learn; §etoggle§r: soul hits.
§6Fallen Strike§r §epress§r: 500 soul damage; 5,000 magicule.
tensura.skill.snake_eye.description:
Builds a debuff on the foe you watch, up to 20 blocks. 80 magicule/s.
§eHold§r to apply the selected effect:
§6Corrosion§r, §6Poison§r (Fatal Poison), §6Paralysis§r, §6Petrification§r or §6Insanity§r.
tensura.skill.solar_beam.description:
30-block light beam: 20 damage; burns through vulnerable blocks and can start fires. 500 magicule + 500/s.
§eHold 2s (0.05s mastered), keep holding§r: fire.
§eRelease§r: stop.
tensura.skill.solar_flare.description:
15-block flash: 200 damage. Status timing appears bugged: blindness 0.05s, nausea/slowness 0s. 35,000 magicule.
§eHold 6s, release§r.
tensura.skill.solar_rain.description:
Fires 10 light arrows (20 mastered), 30 damage each. 8,000 magicule.
§eHold 4s, release§r at a target within 20 blocks (30 mastered).
tensura.skill.solar_wave.description:
Light grenade: 30 area damage within 4 blocks, Blindness I (II mastered) and Slowness II for 15s.
§eHold 3s, release§r to throw.
tensura.skill.space_transform.descriptio:
Deals 2 space damage to creatures within 5 blocks and gives Weakness I for 8s. Slows your movement while active.
§eHold§r to keep it up.
tensura.skill.spatial_domination.descrip:
§bPassive§r: space abilities ×3 (toggle).
§6Warp Shot§r §epress§r: toggle shot warping.
§6Spatial Cleanse§r §epress§r: remove Severance; §esneak+press§r: target within 5.
§6Dimension Ray§r §ehold§r: 30-block beam, 50 damage (200 mastered).
§6Dimension Storm§r §epress§r: 20 rays (30 mastered), 50 damage (100); 50,000 magicule.
§6Fault Field§r §ehold§r: magicule blocks most hits.
tensura.skill.spatial_motion.description:
Teleport to aimed or saved places; cost grows with distance.
§6Blink§r §epress§r: jump up to 30 blocks (50 mastered).
§6Warp§r §epress§r: open travel menu; choose a saved place or warp pad. 5s travel charge (instant mastered).
tensura.skill.spatial_storage.descriptio:
Pocket storage: 54 slots, stacks of 100 (200 mastered).
§eHold 2s, release§r.
§6Spatial Bag§r: creates a bag; mastered: opens storage directly, §esneak+cast§r makes a bag.
§6Dress Change§r (mastered): swaps worn armor with stored armor.
tensura.skill.spearhead.description:
§bPassive§r: allies within 20 blocks gain +10 attack, +5 armor and faster movement/swimming (double mastered). Inherit eligible skills from nearby dead followers.
§ePress§r: all followers stay/follow/wander/shield you.
§eSneak+press§r: order one follower.
tensura.skill.starved.description:
Corrosion can steal skills from its kills.
§6Corrosion§r §ehold§r: 5 damage/0.5s within 5 blocks; slows you.
§6Stomach§r §epress§r: storage.
§6Receive§r §epress§r: copy a follower’s skills.
§6Provide§r: unfinished.
§6Spiritual Domination§r §epress§r: order one follower; §esneak+press§r: all stay/follow/wander/rampage.
tensura.skill.sticky_steel_thread.descri:
Web shots, grappling and magical restraints.
§6Sticky§r / §6Steel§r §epress§r: fire webs.
§6Slinger§r §epress§r: grapple; §esneak+press§r: detach.
§6Arcane Thread Fetters§r §epress§r: Silence for 25s; also Webbed if target EP ≤ yours. Range 10 (20 mastered). Press again within 5s (10 mastered): release for 30 damage (60).
tensura.skill.summon_basilisk.descriptio:
Summons a tame Basilisk to fight for you. Costs 500 magicule, then 100/s.
§eHold 5s (3s mastered), release§r.
§eSneak+press§r at your summon within 30 blocks: dismiss.
tensura.skill.summon_daemon.description:
Calls a daemon; costs twice its EP, reduced by nearby sacrifices. Strong daemons may attack you.
§eHold 15s, release§r.
§6Lesser Daemon§r/§6Greater Daemon§r: choose rank.
§6Arch Daemon§r: mastered rank.
§6Random Daemon§r: random rank.
tensura.skill.summon_hound_dog.descripti:
Summons a tame evolved Hound Dog to fight for you. Costs 50 magicule, then 10/s.
§eHold 5s (3s mastered), release§r.
§eSneak+press§r at your summon within 30 blocks: dismiss.
tensura.skill.summon_otherworlder.descri:
Summons an otherworlder for 3,000,000 magicule; may arrive as a baby.
§eHold§r aiming within 8 blocks: make and charge a circle, 50,000 every 3s (100,000 mastered). Keep holding at the full circle to finish.
tensura.skill.suppressor.description:
Blocks warping and moves entities through space.
§6Spatial Suppression§r §epress§r: foes within 25 blocks cannot warp for 60s.
§6Swap§r §epress§r: trade places with a target within 30 blocks.
§6Spatial Motion§r §epress§r: blink 30 blocks (50 mastered); §esneak+press§r: warp/gate menu.
§eToggle§r: faster chanting, movement and attacks.
tensura.skill.swipe.description:
Space slash: 200 damage (300 mastered) along 15 blocks (20 mastered), pulling targets to you. If none are hit, blinks you forward. 50,000 magicule.
§eHold 3s, release§r.
tensura.skill.thrower.description:
Throws held items (base damage 50; 100 mastered) or air (30; 50 mastered). Special items vary.
§ePress§r: throw; aiming at a creature within 4 blocks shoves it instead.
§eToggle§r: ordinary thrown items home toward your target.
tensura.skill.thunder.description:
Lightning where you aim, up to 30 blocks away: 100 damage in a 3-block radius (200 damage, 5 blocks mastered). 30,000 magicule.
§eHold 1s, release§r.
tensura.skill.thunder_breath.description:
Lightning breath ahead: 10 damage (20 mastered). Costs 50 magicule/s.
§eHold§r to breathe.
tensura.skill.thunder_lance.description:
Lightning lances; 5,000 magicule.
§eHold 4s, release§r.
§6Single§r: one lance, 50 damage plus 30 lightning.
§6Rain§r (mastered): a barrage, 30 damage plus 30 lightning each.
tensura.skill.thunder_orb.description:
Fires a thunder orb that strikes nearby enemies every 0.5s: 80 damage plus 40 lightning, 5-block radius (10 mastered). 20,000 magicule.
§eHold 6s (4s mastered), release§r.
tensura.skill.thunder_rain.description:
Lightning storm or charged hits; 70,000 magicule.
§eHold 8s (5s mastered), release§r.
§6Rain§r: storm follows you, 17.5-block radius; 300 damage every 4s for 30s.
§6Coating§r (mastered): next five physical hits add 100 lightning damage.
tensura.skill.titanification.description:
Grows to ×4 size for 6s: +60 attack damage, +20 armor and longer reach; resists magic.
§ePress§r to grow.
Mastered: §ehold, scroll, release§r to choose size.
§eSneak+press§r: end it.
tensura.skill.tornado_blade.description:
Wind sphere: 150 damage plus 25 wind (300 plus 50 mastered). Mastered: pulls foes and bursts into ten blades, 50 damage each. 40,000 magicule.
§eHold 2.5s, release§r.
tensura.skill.traveler.description:
Blinks and fires spatial arrows.
§6Instant Motion§r §epress§r: blink up to 200 blocks.
§6Teleport§r §epress§r: warp/gate menu.
§6Spatial Manipulation§r §epress§r: toggle Warp Shot.
§6Stardust Arrow§r §epress§r: 30 damage; §esneak+press§r: fire from behind target.
§6Stardust Rain§r §epress§r: 12 ×30-damage arrows; 5,000 each aura/magicule.
§eToggle skill§r: ×2 space power.
tensura.skill.true_darkness.description:
7.5-block darkness cube at your feet: 100 spiritual damage every 0.5s, Darkness and stacking Insanity. 30,000 magicule + 3,000/s.
§eHold 6s, then keep holding§r: sustain up to 10s (20 mastered).
§eRelease§r: stop sustaining.
tensura.skill.unyielding.description:
§bPassive§r: named followers within 30 blocks build points for inheriting their EP and skills on death.
§6Default§r §epress§r at an ally: check points.
§6Backup§r §epress§r: create a spare body (25% max magicule), then swap to it; also saves you on death.
§eSneak+press§r: dismiss backup.
tensura.skill.usurper.description:
Takes random skills from targets within 10 blocks.
§6Rob§r §epress§r: may steal from a stronger foe; 1,000 magicule.
§6Copy§r §epress§r: may copy; 1,000.
§6Force Takeover§r §epress§r: seize a summon (owner ≤75% your EP) for 300s (600 mastered), or rob a weaker foe; 5,000.
§eSneak+press§r in §6Force Takeover§r: return a seized summon.
tensura.skill.villain.description:
§bPassive§r: boosts allies within 15 blocks while equipped.
§6Demon Lord's Haki§r §ehold§r: frighten weaker foes.
§6Villain's Charisma§r §epress§r: control eligible peaceful foes within 10 blocks for 120s (60 if resisted).
§eScroll§r (mastered): Power Scale.
§eToggle§r: more EP from kills; mastered: Haki Coat.
tensura.skill.violent_break.description:
Strengthen I (II mastered) for 60s; removes one level of configured harmful effects, including Bad Omen and Nausea. 150 aura.
§eHold 3s§r to activate.
tensura.skill.warp_portal.description:
Opens a portal to a chosen destination in this dimension; cost grows with distance.
§eHold 4s, release§r: open Spatial Movement.
Choose a destination, then §ePortal§r (5s charge).
tensura.skill.water_domination.descripti:
§bPassive§r: water abilities ×3; toggle on/off.
§eHold§r: water breath, 8 damage (4 mastered).
§eSneak+press§r: water ball, 12 damage.
Both need water nearby or stored water points.
tensura.skill.water_jail.description:
Water cage at your aim, up to 20 blocks: 50 blade + 100 water damage. 25,000 magicule + upkeep.
§eHold 3s, then keep holding§r: sustain up to 8s (14 mastered).
§eRelease§r: stop sustaining.
tensura.skill.weather_domination.descrip:
Sets Overworld weather for 1,200s. 500 magicule.
§ePress§r in §6Clear Weather§r, §6Rain§r or §6Thunder Storm§r to set that weather; works under cover too.
tensura.skill.weather_manipulation.descr:
Sets Overworld weather for 600s. 1,000 magicule.
§ePress§r under open sky in §6Clear Weather§r, §6Rain§r or §6Thunder Storm§r to set that weather.
tensura.skill.wind.description:
Wind burst at your feet pushes creatures away and can launch you upward.
§eHold 1s (0.05s mastered), release§r.
tensura.skill.wind_blade.description:
Fires a wind blade: 20 damage with heavy knockback.
§eHold 2s (1s mastered), release§r.
tensura.skill.wind_domination.descriptio:
§bPassive§r: wind abilities ×3; toggle on/off.
§eHold§r: wind breath, 8 damage (4 mastered); puts out your fire.
§eSneak+press§r: wind sphere, 12 damage and strong knockback.
tensura.skill.wind_manipulation.descript:
§bPassive§r: wind abilities ×1.5; toggle on/off.
§eHold§r: wind breath, 8 damage (4 mastered); puts out your fire.
§eSneak+press§r: wind sphere, 12 damage and strong knockback.
tensura.skill.wind_protection.descriptio:
Wind coat for 120s (180 mastered): +20% speed (+60% mastered) and projectile dodge. Mastered: knockback resistance, shorter burns and stronger fire.
§eHold 3s, release§r.
tensura.skill.wind_transform.description:
Wind deals 2 damage to creatures within 5 blocks and gives Paralysis I for 8s. Slows your movement while active.
§eHold§r to keep it up.
tensura.skill.wrath.description:
Regenerates magicule; risks Rampage and HP/soul loss as it wears off.
§6Breeder Reactor§r §ehold§r: gain 2% max magicule every 5s; may gain Rampage for 30s. Mastered: can toggle.
§6Enrage§r §ehold§r: escalating Rampage on foes within 7 blocks, initially 20s.
